notes: Keywords are verified with Ripper: a candidate is kept only when the lexer emits an :on_kw token for it.
The precedence table is checked against this interpreter by 14 real expressions; the build aborts if any disagree.
Every sample program is executed during the build and its real stdout/stderr/exit status is stored.
Class, method and signature data is not bundled - it is read live from whichever ruby is on PATH at request time.
